site_ui.lead: Turn eligible out-of-network underpayments into disciplined recovery cases, not a volume-driven arbitration gamble.
site_ui.summary: Federal No Surprises Act IDR economics depend on eligibility, applicable state processes, timely open negotiation, evidence quality, and expected incremental collections after administrative, entity, and servicing costs. Keep IDR case administration distinct from contractual underpayment appeals and other lawful out-of-network recovery work, using permitted fixed or collection-based fees without shifting prohibited balances to patients.
flow: Receive authorized claim, remittance, and plan data through HIPAA-compliant workflows.
Determine federal IDR eligibility, applicable state processes, and alternative appeal rights.
Estimate incremental collections net of current fees, labor, loss exposure, and payment delay.
Complete required open negotiation and preserve the evidence and statutory deadlines.
Present a supported offer through the applicable dispute process using current evidentiary and batching rules.
Track determinations and payments, pursue appropriate enforcement, and measure realized contribution margin.
